title: IGN's Top-Reviewed Nintendo Switch 2 Games
take: The Switch 2 has been out for a year, and IGN is already dropping some serious must-play recommendations! Forget endless searching, they've rounded up all the Nintendo-exclusive games that scored an 8 or above, and frankly, we're stoked. Topping the list is a surprising 10/10 for "Donkey Kong Bananza," hailed as a groundbreaking 3D platformer that might just be the best decision Nintendo could've made, even over a Mario title. Plus, enhanced editions of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild are making us want to dive back in, confirming the Switch 2 is truly delivering on the exclusive front. Time to get gaming!

title: The Ultralight Gaming Mouse Arms Race Has Entered a New Phase
take: The ultralight gaming mouse scene is wild right now, and it seems like everyone has a different idea of what makes the ultimate pointer! Corsair's Sabre V2 Pro is all about shedding grams, hitting an incredible 36g by ditching some features and even a bit of build quality, but still delivering fantastic performance for those lightning-fast FPS flicks. Meanwhile, Razer's Viper V4 Pro is refining the basics with a new 50,000 DPI sensor and faster optical switches, while Logitech's G Pro X2 Superstrike is borrowing haptic feedback and rapid trigger from keyboards. It's fascinating to see these heavy hitters taking such diverse paths – what's your pick for the best way to lighten up your game?

title: Star Citizen Spinoff Squadron 42 Delayed to 2027, Dev Insists It's Because of GTA 6
take: Well, here we go again! Star Citizen's single-player epic, Squadron 42, has been pushed back to Q2 2027. Cloud Imperium Games CEO Chris Roberts insists it's all because Grand Theft Auto 6 is going to hog all the attention this fall, meaning his "spiritual successor to Wing Commander" wouldn't get its due. While it’s certainly true that GTA 6 is a massive deal, it’s hard to ignore that Squadron 42 has been in development for over a decade with a star-studded cast and a budget that rivals Rockstar's behemoth, yet still struggles to lock down a launch date. This latest delay, following a messy Star Citizen dev stream, adds another chapter to the ongoing saga of a game that keeps us waiting.

title: Rockstar Games Finally Addresses Extraordinary and 'Heartbreaking' GTA 6 Leaks, Warns Players That 'Some Spoilers' May Now Impact 'The Intended Game Experience'
take: It’s been a rough week for Rockstar, who finally addressed the “heartbreaking” GTA 6 leaks! With over a dozen gameplay clips (and counting!) flooding the internet, the studio acknowledged that some of its intended surprises for players might now be spoiled. While they’re obviously not thrilled about their super-secret game being broadcast this way, Rockstar is still hyping us up for a November 19 launch and promising an "Extended Look" reveal soon. It seems these leaks are still a mystery, but one thing's for sure: gamers are buzzing, and this just makes us even more curious to see the finished product!

title: GTA 6 Leaker Releases Nightclub Gameplay Video, Defends Crypto Scheme
take: The GTA 6 leaks just keep coming, with a new video showing Jason cycling on a beach packed with NPCs – which is great for fans, but terrible for Rockstar. This "CyberLeek" character is still pushing their bizarre crypto scheme, claiming they're fighting for gamers and taking "huge risks" by spoiling the game. With the official Netflix reveal just around the corner, we hope Rockstar can still deliver that incredible first look despite the constant drip-feed of stolen content. Honestly, we're just ready for the real deal!

title: Exclusive: PokémonXP and 2026 Pokémon World Championships Pokémon Center Merch Reveal
take: Get ready to snag some serious Pokémon loot because the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in San Francisco are dropping exclusive merch that’s out of this world! Not only is it the 30th Anniversary, but also the first official PokémonXP fan-convention, meaning triple the awesome with three distinct product lines. We're talking a brand-new accessorized Pikachu plush from the legendary Steiff (their previous ones went for $400!), glow-in-the-dark Umbreon and Elgyem items, and even lava flow glitter pins. Head to the Pokémon Center pop-up, grab a store reservation, and get ready to enter the lottery for those must-have items!

title: GTA 6 Leaker Releases More Gameplay Videos Despite Rockstar Owner Take-Two's Microsoft and Discord Subpoenas
take: The GTA 6 saga just got wilder! Despite Take-Two’s legal moves against Microsoft and Discord to unmask the leaker, “CyberLeek” dropped *two more* gameplay videos this week. We’re talking supercar action, an armed robbery, and even a strip club scene that seems to be directly taunting Take-Two. These new leaks bring the total to eight this week alone, all pushing a memecoin as part of what looks like a big crypto stunt. With significant story spoilers now a real threat, and Rockstar still scratching their heads over how this is happening, you gotta wonder if anything can stop this leaker!

title: The Sinking City 2 Review
take: Get ready for some Lovecraftian horror, folks, because The Sinking City 2 is diving deep into the weird! This survival horror sequel from Frogwares is being hailed as "Resident Evil in a fedora," and that's a huge compliment for fans of modern RE games. With its gorgeous, detailed 1920s Arkham setting, an intriguing cosmic horror plot, and a charmingly pulpy protagonist, Calvin Rafferty, it sounds like a truly atmospheric and engaging experience. Plus, with unkillable stalkers and fishy monstrosities, it promises to keep you on the edge of your seat!

title: Woot Is Practically Giving Away Sonic Games to New Customers Today
take: New players, get ready to zoom! Woot is practically gifting Sonic games today, and if you’ve never shopped with the Amazon-owned retailer, you’re in for a treat. For a measly dollar, you can snag Sonic x Shadow Generations on Switch or Xbox, or grab Sonic Racing Crossworlds for only eight bucks on Switch. Just punch in the promo code HELLOTEN at checkout for a sweet $10 off your first order. This is a fantastic chance to jump into some critically acclaimed Sonic action without breaking the bank!

title: Arc Raiders Gets Unlikely Subway Crossover — Buy a Meal for Exclusive Outfits
take: Who knew a Footlong could get you battle-ready? Embark Studios' intense extraction shooter, Arc Raiders, is getting a super unexpected crossover with Subway, letting you deck out your Raider in sandwich-inspired gear. Just buy a qualifying meal and snag a code for exclusive Subterranean outfits and weekly rotating in-game goodies, all leading up to the massive Frozen Trail update on October 8th. It's definitely a wild way to fuel up for the new map, challenges, and deeper progression coming to the game.

title: Tides of Annihilation is a Stylish King Arthur-Inspired Slash ‘Em Up that Balances Spectacle with Substance | IGN Preview
take: Tides of Annihilation is shaping up to be a stunning Arthurian slash 'em up! This King Arthur-inspired action-RPG, from first-time developer Eclipse Glow Games, had some initial style-over-substance worries, but a recent preview confirms it’s just as exhilarating to play as it is dazzling to watch. Imagine hopping off at Waterloo and ending up in an Elden Ring-esque, blighted London—that's the vibe! While Gwendolyn's movement needs a tiny tweak, the combat, featuring spectral Round Table knights and flashy ultimate skills, sounds incredibly satisfying. Get ready to hack and slash through a ruined British Museum when this one hits!

title: Drakong’s New Attack on Titan-Themed Collectible Controllers Come In a Blind Box
take: Alright, Attack on Titan fans, get ready to add some serious cuteness to your gaming setup! Hyperkin’s sub-brand Drakong just dropped the PixelByte controllers, tiny, pixelated NES-style controllers featuring chibi versions of your favorite AoT characters like Eren and Levi. And here's the kicker: they're coming in blind boxes! While we probably won't be using these keychain-sized beauties to beat Elden Ring, they're fully functional with PC, Switch, iOS, and Android, offering 12 hours of playtime. With seven different variants (plus a super rare chase controller!), getting your hands on a specific character might be a gamble, but the thrill of the unboxing and adding a new collectible to your shrine is totally worth it. Pre-order yours for $24.99 and start collecting!

title: Star Wars: Magellan Was a AAA Action RPG Where You Could Play as a Jedi or Mandalorian
take: Woah, another Star Wars game bites the dust! Footage just dropped for *Star Wars: Magellan*, a totally scrapped action RPG that would’ve let us finally choose between playing as a Jedi *or* a Mandalorian. Imagine the possibilities! Developed by the now-closed Echtra Games, this "shoot and loot" title had big plans, including a companion bond system and epic Force powers versus jetpack flamethrowers. It’s a real bummer to see such an ambitious project, codenamed Magellan, join the graveyard of canceled Star Wars dreams like *1313*. What a missed opportunity for PC, Xbox, and PS5 players!

title: 'I Want to Set the Record Straight: That Is Not Happening' — Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
take: Good news, Kingdom Hearts fans! Co-director Tai Yasue and series creator Tetsuya Nomura just dropped some serious truth bombs at D23 2026, squashing all those "will it, won't it" delay rumors for Kingdom Hearts 4. They're 100% committed to a late 2027 launch, promising smooth development and no last-minute pushbacks. That means we can all stop worrying about a wait longer than the 13 years between KH2 and 3, and breathe a sigh of relief about getting a physical release before Sony's 2028 cutoff. Get ready for more Disney magic and hopefully, some familiar Final Fantasy faces on PC, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S!

title: I Hope GTA 6 Borrows a Lot From GTA 4
take: Grand Theft Auto 4 is still a blast, even 18 years later! One gamer recently revisited Liberty City and found Niko Bellic’s grimy, lived-in world and notoriously tricky driving controls oddly charming. While GTA 5 offered more polished handling, the loose, dangerous feel of GTA 4’s vehicles added unexpected thrills to every chase. Plus, the surprisingly deep relationship system was a cool way to experience moving to a new city, rewarding players for building bonds and unlocking perks like weapons and even helicopters. Here's hoping GTA 6 takes notes from this classic’s unique charm and finds a sweet spot between old-school grit and modern polish!

title: Xbox's Separation from Compulsion Games Seems Complete as Studio Is Listed as the Publisher of South of Midnight on Steam
take: Big news for fans of Compulsion Games' upcoming South of Midnight! It looks like their independence from Xbox is officially complete, with the studio now listed as the publisher on Steam. This is a huge win for creative freedom and signals a fresh start for the award-winning game, ensuring Compulsion gets to chart its own course for its 2025 release. While other recently independent studios like Double Fine are still under the Xbox Game Studios publishing umbrella for older titles, Compulsion’s move is a clear statement of autonomy. Get ready to support Compulsion directly when South of Midnight drops!

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave – The Final Preview
take: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave is almost here, and it sounds like Intelligent Systems is taking some big swings, leaning into individual hero stories right from the start. We’re hyped for the new Blaze Arts moves, adding a cool risk/reward to combat that could seriously shake up your battle strategies. The ability to hop between story paths is awesome, but a potentially annoying save-game system might make seeing *everything* a bit of a grind. Get ready for a fresh take on the Three Houses world, even if it means a little save-scumming!

title: Sony Predicts Influx of New Players as Helldivers 2 Drops on the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog Alongside New Update and Warhammer 40,000 Warbond
take: Helldivers 2 just landed on PlayStation Plus with a bang, bringing a massive new update and a sweet Warhammer 40,000 Warbond! If you’ve been waiting to dive into the fastest-selling PlayStation Studios game ever, now’s your chance as it joins the Game Catalog for Extra and Premium members. Get ready for a huge influx of new recruits joining the fight, because Sony is predicting millions more players, ready to take on the new horror-themed narrative arc and mutated Illuminate organisms. This major patch, Devoid of Liberty, sounds like it's going to warp everything we know about Helldivers!

title: Selling Impossible Pokémon: Ban Reports Point to Long-Rumored Black Market for 'Injecting' Rare Pokémon Go Quests, Sparking Speculation of Insider Involvement
take: Well, this is one way to catch 'em all! It looks like some Pokémon Go players have been getting a little *too* adventurous with their rare creature collection, allegedly tapping into a black market that "injects" impossible questlines directly into their accounts. Imagine paying hundreds for a Pokémon you're not even supposed to have yet, only for the game's developer, Scopely Explore, to drop the ban hammer! While it's unclear if this "injecting" required a hacker or an insider, these new 30-day suspensions for "unauthorized" quest access strongly suggest that those long-rumored shady dealings were absolutely real. Looks like some trainers are learning the hard way that cutting corners in Pokémon Go just isn't worth it.

title: 'We're Totally Supporting It' — Take-Two Boss Says Borderlands 4 Performance 'Has Not Affected Our Plans at All' as Fans Await Year 2 Roadmap
take: Borderlands 4 fans, wondering about the future of their favorite looter shooter, just got some official reassurance! Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick insists that despite some community concerns about its performance, support for Borderlands 4 is full steam ahead. We're getting a new Vault Hunter, Loveless the Hacker, in Story Pack 2 this September, alongside Bounty Pack 5 and Version 1.10. While a Year 2 roadmap is still under wraps, it's great to hear that past PC performance hiccups and "softness" in sales haven't derailed plans. Here's hoping Loveless breathes new life into the game and we see that Year 2 content drop soon!

title: 'If You're Not a Netflix Subscriber, You Definitely Should Be' — Take-Two Boss Teases Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
take: The GTA 6 hype train just hit a new stop, and it’s… Netflix? Rockstar’s parent company Take-Two is betting big on an exclusive six-hour window for "Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look" on the streaming giant before it hits YouTube. While some might grumble about this "paywalling" of a trailer, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick is confident everyone will tune in, hinting this won't be just a standard gameplay trailer, but something much grander. Could this be a mini-documentary or even feel like a Netflix show episode? Whatever it is, mark your calendars for August 27 – just be ready to potentially sign up for Netflix if you can’t wait those extra six hours!

title: Sega Is Auctioning Off Shadow The Hedgehog's Real-Life Motorcycle For a Good Cause
take: Shadow the Hedgehog fans, get ready to open your wallets for a fantastic cause! Sega is auctioning off the real-life Dark Rider motorcycle, built for the "Fearless: Year of Shadow" campaign, with all proceeds going to the Luca Guintoli Foundation. While this custom-built beast sadly won't actually zoom (it needs some serious love to run!), it's an incredible, unique piece of Sega history and film memorabilia. This is a rare chance to own a direct piece of Sega's legacy and help children with autism or cancer – how cool is that?

title: Amazon Knocks $10 off Physical Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Preorders
take: Get ready to hit the virtual waves, Games4All fam, because Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is hitting preorders with a sweet deal! Amazon is currently offering the physical edition for just $49.94, a cool ten bucks off the usual price. This is a big win for those of us who still love collecting physical games, especially since Nintendo is still fully supporting boxed releases on the Switch 2, unlike some other console makers who are going all-digital. Plus, early previews are raving about the return to Wuhu Island and the improved Joy-Con 2 controls, promising to fix past issues and deliver a truly distinct sporting experience. Looks like our next party game just got a whole lot more appealing!

title: 007 First Light's Legacy Edition Hits Record Low Price via Limited-Time Coupon at Amazon
take: Calling all secret agents and collectors! The incredible 007 First Light Legacy Edition just hit a new record-low price on Amazon. With insane coupons bringing the PS5 version down to $156.47 and Xbox Series X to $161.69, you're not just getting the highly-praised game (one of IGN's faves of 2026!), but a treasure trove of Bond goodies. That Golden Gun figurine with a secret compartment and exclusive DLC like the Golden Gun and Obsidian Gold Suit skins? Yes, please! This is the perfect chance to dive into a game brimming with gadgets, guns, and girls, all while scoring some serious collector's swag.

title: Beaten Path Revealed for PC and Consoles
take: Get ready for a tactical RPG that's bursting with promise, because Beaten Path is bringing serious Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics vibes to PC and consoles in 2027! This solo-developed gem, from the mind of Jarett Gross, promises deep strategic combat on grid-based maps, where every position and height matters. With over 25 fully voice-acted, recruitable characters, a dual-job system, and a ton of customization, party-building looks like a blast – and the fact that its Kickstarter funded in just six days tells you gamers are hyped! Prepare to uncover secrets, sail continents, and spend serious time in its world of ancient machines and fallen gods; this isn't just about the battles!

title: Everything Announced in The Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Nintendo Direct
take: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is bringing back that Three Houses magic, and we're officially hyped! This upcoming Switch 2 exclusive looks like a massive return to form, ditching the so-so Engage for a truly epic new adventure. With four distinct character stories, time-travel shenanigans, and the Heroic Games serving as a Roman-style arena for glory, it's packed with choices and colorful characters. Plus, the ability to jump between all four heroes with the Pale Raven? Yes, please! Get ready for September 17th, because this one's going to be huge.

title: Rust Fan Sues Police After Swatting Incident Leaves Him Paralyzed
take: This is a truly horrifying story that reminds us of the darker side of online gaming. A Rust player, Axeel Melendez, is suing the police for a massive $176 million after a swatting incident left him paralyzed. Melendez had actually warned authorities he was being targeted by a swatter after a hacker accessed his personal details through Rust, demanded money, and then threatened him with the fake police call. Despite his efforts to alert the police, officers still stormed his home, shooting him in the leg and spine. It's a stark, tragic reminder that actions in online games can have devastating real-world consequences, and that swatting is a terrifying threat to gamers everywhere.

title: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
take: Elden Ring players are in a frenzy! FromSoftware dropped a mysterious social media post featuring a tranquil ride through Siofra River, and the internet exploded with theories about a potential Godwyn DLC. After two years since the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, fans are *desperate* for more, interpreting every subtle detail in the 12-second clip as a hint. While it could just be hype for the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 Tarnished Edition or even the Elden Ring movie, gamers are crossing their fingers for a massive new adventure in the Lands Between. We love the dedication, Tarnished!

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leak on Social Media Reportedly Seen by Millions Before Sony Took It Down
take: Woah, talk about a major spoiler! Spider-Man: Brand New Day just hit theaters, but a full, high-quality bootleg apparently streamed across X/Twitter and was seen by millions before Sony could pull the plug. This is a huge bummer for the movie and for fans who wanted to experience the big reveals in theaters. With a 7/10 review from IGN and massive box office previews, it’s a shame this leak potentially spoiled the fun for so many, especially since Sony was already trying to combat post-credits scene leaks!

title: Stellar Blade: Blood Rain Dev Shift Up Releases Entirely AI-Generated K-Pop Music Video Starring Evie and Pretty Much Everyone Hates It
take: Looks like Stellar Blade: Blood Rain developer Shift Up just dropped an AI-generated K-Pop music video for their game, and wow, did it miss the mark! Starring protagonist Evie, the "Wanna be in LOVE" video has fans absolutely ripping into it, citing weird facial changes and visual glitches that make it look more like a bad YouTube ad than a polished game promo. The internet is flooded with comments like "AI slop" and worries about the game itself using AI in cutscenes. Shift Up's CEO is a big fan of generative AI, but this video is definitely not winning over the gaming community, and it's even hurting some players' hype for the game. Talk about a misfire!
